investigation_notes.Description: Logo scanner flagged Vitalis Healthcare branding on the contact page of vitali-pharmacy.it. The screenshot shows a local Italian pharmacy using the name 'VITALI Farmacia' with a heart/leaf style logo and a standard contact form with address and email, with no obvious credential collection or deceptive UI elements. The domain is 8 years old, hosted via Cloudflare with a clean abuse score, and there are no recent similar alerts; based on the visual differences in brand name, benign page context, and clean infrastructure reputation, this is assessed as Low Priority.
